title: Palindrome Linked List
question: How do you check if a linked list is a palindrome in O(n) time and O(1) space?
seoKeywords: linked list palindrome O(1) space java
realWorldScenario: Find middle with fast/slow, reverse second half, compare with first half, then restore list.

title: Reverse in K-Groups — Concept

seoKeywords: reverse k group linked list java
searchIntent: reverse k groups linked list java interview
realWorldScenario: For each group of k: check k nodes exist, reverse them, recurse/iterate on the rest. Connect reversed group to next group's head.
